title: It's Coming… The Biggest Stock Buying Opportunity in 25 Years
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: AI stocks are ~40-50% of the S&P 500, dot-com territory; a bust is eventually coming, best guess broad sale in 2028-2029 with cracks in the next ~12 months.
OpenAI/Anthropic burn cash with huge compute commitments while hyperscalers increasingly fund capex with debt, which a debt downgrade could unravel.
Hide in staples, healthcare, insurance, energy, gold, value, equal-weight (RSP) and T-bills paying ~4.1%; utilities are no longer safe.
With inflation at 3.7% and a September hike, the Fed may not cut aggressively in a bust.
